name: Grupo SATA (SATA Holding)
note: Azores airline group: SATA Holding controls the operating subsidiaries SATA Air Açores, Azores Airlines and SGA (European Commission press release approving restructuring aid, 7 June 2022), and is owned by the Regional Government of the Azores (same release; Reuters via O Jornal/Herald News, 8 Sept 2026). A privatisation of Azores Airlines (sale of at least 75% via private negotiation) is running in 2026, with no completed sale reported as of 3 October 2026.
